story:
Ethan carried his small blue backpack across the sunny park, because today was fossil-hunting day. [emotion:QT/happy] His heart felt as light as a feather. He spotted a good digging spot near the tall oak tree and knelt down carefully.

[emotion:QT/surprised] Suddenly, a boy named Leo appeared beside him. "Can I dig too?" Leo asked, holding a red shovel hopefully.

[emotion:QT/shy] Ethan felt worried at first, so he paused and looked at his hands. Leo waited patiently without rushing him.

"Okay," Ethan said quietly. "You dig there, then I dig here."

They took turns scooping the soft, brown dirt carefully. Leo found a smooth, flat rock shaped like a triangle. [emotion:QT/surprised] [emotion:QT/happy] "Maybe that's a tooth!" Ethan said, eyes wide.

[gesture:clapping] [emotion:QT/happy] "We found it together!" Leo cheered. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan smiled because having a helper made everything feel easier.

[emotion:QT/happy] Walking home, Ethan felt grateful. Digging was fun, but finding a friend felt even better.

takeaways: Working together with a friend helps you solve problems faster.
Giving someone a chance, even when you feel nervous, can lead to a great friendship.
Taking turns makes things fair and fun for everyone.
